import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff()
def factor(i):
 v=R.iloc[i-19:i+1].std()+1e-12
 trend=R.iloc[i-39:i+1].sum()/v
 downside=R.iloc[i-19:i+1].clip(upper=0).sum()/v
 # inverse medium trend, strengthened when downside dominates recent path
 confirm=np.clip(1+0.30*(-downside/np.sqrt(20)),0.7,1.3)
 return -trend*confirm
rows=[]; sig=[]; h=5
for i in range(120,len(P)-h):
 f=factor(i); y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1
 z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 for s,a in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)})
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('horizon 5 dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.sum()/(len(x)*15),5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-03-05')]:
 q=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(q),'IC',round(q.ic.mean(),6) if len(q) else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310306_inverse_trend_confirmation_5d_signal.csv',index=False)

| Factor | Horizon | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Turnover | Result |

- 2025–2027: -0.031211
- 2028–2029: -0.012546

- 2020–2024: +0.004438
- 2025–2027: +0.020356

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff()
def factor(i):
 r5=R.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum(); v5=R.iloc[i-4:i+1].std()+1e-12; v60=R.iloc[i-59:i+1].std()+1e-12
 shock=np.clip(v5/v60,0.5,3.0)
 # short-horizon reversal, amplified only after an idiosyncratic volatility shock
 return -r5/(v5*np.sqrt(5))*shock
rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(120,len(P)-10):
 f=factor(i)
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-04-02')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); M=R.mean(axis=1)
rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(120,len(P)-21):
    rr=R.iloc[i-59:i+1]; r5=R.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum(); vol60=rr.std()+1e-12
    # remove common market move, then seek short-term dislocation; amplify only in
    # high-dispersion environments where cross-asset relative pricing is strongest.
    beta=rr.cov().div(rr.var()+1e-12,axis=0)
    resid=r5-beta*(M.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum())
    disp=rr.std(axis=1).mean()
    baseline=R.iloc[i-119:i+1].std(axis=1).mean() if i>=120 else disp
    gate=np.clip(disp/(baseline+1e-12)-0.8,0,1.2)
    f=(-resid/(vol60*np.sqrt(5)))*(1+0.45*gate)
    for h in (5,10):
      y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
      if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
    sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-04-30')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310501_dispersion_residual_reversal_5d_signal.csv',index=False)

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); M=R.mean(axis=1)
rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(120,len(P)-21):
    rr=R.iloc[i-59:i+1]; r5=R.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum(); vol60=rr.std()+1e-12
    beta=rr.apply(lambda x: x.cov(M.iloc[i-59:i+1]),axis=0)/(M.iloc[i-59:i+1].var()+1e-12)
    resid=r5-beta*(M.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum())
    disp=rr.std(axis=1).mean(); baseline=R.iloc[i-119:i+1].std(axis=1).mean()
    gate=np.clip(disp/(baseline+1e-12)-0.8,0,1.2)
    f=(-resid/(vol60*np.sqrt(5)))*(1+0.45*gate)
    for h in (5,10):
      y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
      if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
    sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-04-30')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310501_dispersion_residual_reversal_5d_signal.csv',index=False)

### Explored Factors

1. **Dispersion-gated residual reversal**
   - Removes the estimated common cross-asset market component from each asset’s five-day return.
   - Normalizes residual reversal by 60-day volatility.
   - Applies a stronger reversal signal during elevated cross-asset dispersion.
   - Evaluated across all 15 tradable instruments using causal data through 2031-04-30.

2. **Downside-quality defensive factor**
   - Combines downside volatility relative to total volatility with a mild total-volatility penalty.
   - Intended to identify assets with more stable and defensive return profiles.
   - Evaluated at five- and ten-day forward horizons.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Dispersion-gated residual reversal | 5d | 2,182 | 14.65 | 97.684% | +0.023998 | +0.077265 | 51.925% | 0.150867 | **Failed ICIR** |
| Dispersion-gated residual reversal | 10d | 2,172 | 14.54 | 96.934% | +0.012399 | +0.041237 | 52.026% | — | **Failed ICIR** |
| Downside-quality defensive factor | 5d | 2,182 | 14.65 | 97.684% | −0.020475 | −0.065847 | 46.517% | 0.034050 | **Failed IC/ICIR** |
| Downside-quality defensive factor | 10d | 2,172 | 14.54 | 96.934% | −0.028817 | −0.094572 | 44.337% | — | **Failed IC sign/gate** |

Regime IC for the dispersion-gated residual reversal factor remained positive in the first three regimes but weakened materially in 2030–2031:

- 2020–2024: +0.020749
- 2025–2027: +0.035997
- 2028–2029: +0.026342
- 2030–2031-04-30: +0.004649

The downside-quality factor was negative across all tested regimes.

### Persistence Actions

- No factors were persisted.
- The dispersion-gated residual reversal factor did not meet the benchmark ICIR threshold of 0.0840.
- The downside-quality factor failed both predictive-strength and stability requirements.
- Signal artifacts were generated for audit:
  - `scripts/miner_3_20310501_dispersion_residual_reversal_5d_signal.csv`
  - `scripts/miner_3_20310501_downside_quality_signal.csv`

### Current Effective Factors

The previously admitted factor remains effective based on its latest validation:

- **`miner_3_20310417_downside_anchored_reversal_5d`**
  - IC: +0.032356
  - ICIR: +0.103332
  - Coverage: 97.673%
  - Turnover: 0.150935
  - Last validated: 2031-04-17
  - Status: EFFECTIVE

The newly tested dispersion-residual factor appears directionally useful but does not currently satisfy the stability gate. Its recent-period attenuation also warrants caution before any future re-test.

### Plans

- Investigate lower-turnover residual-reversal variants with stronger smoothing and longer signal half-life.
- Test conditional combinations using recent market breadth and volatility-regime changes.
- Avoid further standalone low-volatility quality signals unless their factor direction is reformulated.
- Continue monitoring correlation and redundancy with the existing reversal-heavy factor library.

rows=[]; sig=[]

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}; V={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); d=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date'); C[s]=d.close.astype(float); V[s]=d.volume.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); Vol=pd.DataFrame(V).reindex(P.index); R=np.log(P).diff(); M=R.mean(axis=1); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(120,len(P)-21):
 rr=R.iloc[i-59:i+1]; m=M.iloc[i-59:i+1]; beta=rr.apply(lambda x:x.cov(m),axis=0)/(m.var()+1e-12)
 resid=R.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum()-beta*m.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum(); v=rr.std()+1e-12
 # causal volume shock: current 5d average relative to prior 40d average
 volshock=(Vol.iloc[i-4:i+1].mean()/(Vol.iloc[i-44:i-4].mean()+1e-12)-1).clip(-0.5,2.0)
 # reversals after abnormal activity receive a modest amplification
 f=-resid/(v*np.sqrt(5))*(1+0.40*volshock.clip(lower=0))
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-05-28')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310529_volume_shock_residual_reversal_5d_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); d=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date'); C[s]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
# Candidate: medium-horizon return divided by recent volatility, with a causal volatility-regime penalty.
# This is a single interpretable risk-adjusted momentum idea.
for i in range(120,len(P)-21):
 r20=R.iloc[i-19:i+1].sum(); r60=R.iloc[i-59:i+1].sum(); v20=R.iloc[i-19:i+1].std()+1e-12; v60=R.iloc[i-59:i+1].std()+1e-12
 # 60d return, risk-adjusted by 20d vol; penalize assets whose short vol is elevated vs long vol
 f=(r60/(v20*np.sqrt(20)))*(1/(1+((v20/v60-1).clip(lower=0))))
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-06-11')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310612_risk_adjusted_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']

P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]

for i in range(80,len(P)-21):
 v20=R.iloc[i-19:i+1].std(); v60=R.iloc[i-59:i+1].std()+1e-12
 # prefer low absolute vol but avoid simply selecting stale series: reward falling vol ratio
 f=-(v20/v20.median()) + 0.35*(1-v20/v60)

 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)

 # causal volume shock: current 5d average relative to prior 40d average

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); d=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date'); C[s]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); M=R.mean(axis=1); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(120,len(P)-21):
 rr=R.iloc[i-59:i+1]; m=M.iloc[i-59:i+1]
 beta=rr.apply(lambda x:x.cov(m),axis=0)/(m.var()+1e-12)
 resid=R.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum()-beta*m.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum(); v=rr.std()+1e-12
 # Cross-sectional dispersion is lagged/causal. Gate only above its 60d median.
 disp=R.iloc[i].std(); hist=R.iloc[i-59:i+1].std(axis=1).median(); gate=np.clip(disp/(hist+1e-12)-1, -0.5, 1.0)
 f=-resid/(v*np.sqrt(5))*(1+0.45*max(gate,0))
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-06-25')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310626_dispersion_gated_residual_reversal_5d_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); M=R.mean(axis=1); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(120,len(P)-21):
 rr=R.iloc[i-59:i+1]; m=M.iloc[i-59:i+1]
 beta=rr.apply(lambda x:x.cov(m),axis=0)/(m.var()+1e-12)
 resid=R.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum()-beta*m.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum(); v=rr.std()+1e-12
 # causal downside-dispersion regime: dispersion of negative 20d asset returns relative to 60d baseline
 r20=R.iloc[i-19:i+1].sum(); downside=r20.where(r20<0,0.0)
 dd=downside.std(); base=R.iloc[i-59:i+1].sum(axis=1).std()+1e-12
 gate=np.clip(dd/(base*np.sqrt(20)),0,2.0)
 f=-resid/(v*np.sqrt(5))*(1+0.45*gate)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:

 resid=R.iloc[i-2:i+1].sum()-beta*m.iloc[i-2:i+1].sum(); v=rr.std()+1e-12
 f=-resid/(v*np.sqrt(3))

  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-07-31')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310807_fast_residual_reversal_3d_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); d=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date'); C[s]=d.close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
# Downside-semivariance quality: assets with relatively small downside risk,
# while rewarding positive skew (downside volatility below total volatility).
for i in range(80,len(P)-21):
 r20=R.iloc[i-19:i+1]; r60=R.iloc[i-59:i+1]
 down20=r20.clip(upper=0).pow(2).mean().pow(0.5)
 total60=r60.std()+1e-12
 asym=down20/(total60)
 f=-(asym/asym.median()) + 0.25*((r20.mean()/total60)/(r20.mean()/total60).abs().median()+1e-12)
 # cleaner bounded cross-sectional rank-like signal
 f=f.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-08-19')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310821_downside_semivariance_signal.csv',index=False)

## Factor Mining Cycle Summary — miner_3

**Validation date:** 2031-08-21  
**Universe:** 15 tradable benchmark instruments  
**Data through:** 2031-08-19  
**Minimum cross-sectional observation:** 8 instruments

### Explored Factors

1. **Downside-semivariance quality**
   - Penalizes assets with high recent downside semivariance relative to 60-day total volatility.
   - Includes a small positive-skew adjustment based on recent return relative to volatility.
   - Intended to identify assets with defensive downside characteristics.

2. **Low-volatility and volatility-compression factor**
   - Favors low 20-day realized volatility relative to the cross-sectional median.
   - Adds a modest reward when short-term volatility declines relative to 60-day volatility.
   - Intended as a defensive, lower-turnover allocation signal.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit Ratio | Turnover | Status |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Downside-semivariance quality | 5d | 2,277 | 14.66 | 97.751% | -0.019419 | -0.066117 | 46.992% | 0.069344 | Failed |
| Downside-semivariance quality | 10d | 2,267 | 14.55 | 97.003% | -0.006152 | -0.020894 | 48.699% | — | Failed |
| Low-volatility/compression | 5d | 2,277 | 14.66 | 97.751% | -0.016591 | -0.049944 | 46.552% | 0.028508 | Failed |
| Low-volatility/compression | 10d | 2,267 | 14.55 | 97.003% | -0.020513 | -0.062933 | 47.640% | — | Failed |

The benchmark admission gates are absolute daily paper IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute daily paper ICIR ≥ 0.0840. Neither candidate met both thresholds.

#### Regime Diagnostics

**Downside-semivariance quality, 5-day horizon:**

- 2020–2024: IC -0.012468
- 2025–2027: IC -0.031389
- 2028–2029: IC -0.003869
- 2030–2031-08-19: IC -0.033688

**Low-volatility/compression, 5-day horizon:**

- 2020–2024: IC -0.040543
- 2025–2027: IC +0.004411
- 2028–2029: IC -0.014271
- 2030–2031-08-19: IC -0.008354

Both factors showed negative or unstable predictive relationships across regimes. The low-volatility signal did have very low turnover, but this did not compensate for its consistently negative IC.

### Persistence Actions

No factors were persisted.

- `scripts/miner_3_20310821_downside_semivariance.py`
- `scripts/miner_3_20310821_downside_semivariance_signal.csv`
- `scripts/miner_3_20310821_low_volatility.py`
- `scripts/miner_3_20310821_low_volatility_signal.csv`

No candidate achieved the IC/ICIR admission gates, so no `EFFECTIVE` factor file was created.

### Current Effective Factors

The existing factor library remains unchanged. Relevant effective residual-reversal factors continue to include previously validated constructions such as:

- `miner_3_20310724_stress_residual_reversal_5d`
- Earlier smooth, dispersion-gated, defensive, and residual-reversal variants from miner_3 and other miners

The latest miner_3 stress-residual family has shown strong full-history results but weakening recent-regime IC. This remains a monitoring concern, particularly given the high overlap among residual-reversal variants.

### Plans

- Avoid adding standalone low-volatility or downside-risk factors unless their sign and regime behavior improve materially.
- Explore orthogonal factors based on:
  - Cross-asset leadership dispersion and breadth transitions
  - Relative strength conditioned on macro trend or volatility regimes
  - Volume-price confirmation with longer holding horizons
  - Defensive asset rotation signals using XAU, US10Y, CN10Y, and low-beta equity indices
- Continue requiring recent-regime validation and deterministic library-correlation analysis before persistence.
- Retain the generated signal artifacts for future combination testing, but do not treat them as effective factors.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); M=R.mean(axis=1); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(120,len(P)-21):
 rr=R.iloc[i-59:i+1]; m=M.iloc[i-59:i+1]
 beta=rr.apply(lambda x:x.cov(m),axis=0)/(m.var()+1e-12)
 shock=R.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum()-beta*m.iloc[i-4:i+1].sum(); v=rr.std()+1e-12
 # Breadth transition: amplify mean-reversion after a sharp deterioration in cross-sectional breadth.
 b20=(R.iloc[i-19:i+1]>0).mean(axis=1).mean(); b5=(R.iloc[i-4:i+1]>0).mean(axis=1).mean()
 transition=np.clip((b20-b5)*4.0,-1,1)
 # positive transition boosts reversal, negative transition mildly suppresses it
 f=-shock/(v*np.sqrt(5))*(1+0.55*max(transition,0)-0.20*max(-transition,0))
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-09-02')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310904_breadth_transition_reversal_5d_signal.csv',index=False)

## Factor Mining Cycle Summary — miner_3

**Validation date:** 2031-09-04  
**Data through:** 2031-09-02  
**Universe:** 15 tradable benchmark instruments  
**Minimum cross-sectional observation:** 8 instruments

### Explored Factor

**Breadth-transition amplified residual reversal**

- Computes five-day beta-adjusted residual returns relative to the cross-asset benchmark.
- Normalizes residual shocks by 60-day volatility.
- Amplifies the reversal signal when recent five-day market breadth deteriorates relative to 20-day breadth.
- Mildly suppresses reversal exposure when breadth improves.
- Uses only causal price data available before each forecast date.

### Validation Results

| Horizon | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit Ratio | Turnover | Result |

- Absolute IC: **0.029295 ≥ 0.0070**
- Absolute ICIR: **0.093233 ≥ 0.0840**

Regime IC for the five-day horizon:

- 2020–2024: **+0.036550**
- 2025–2027: **+0.040183**

- 2030–2031-09-02: **+0.002345**

The factor remained positive across all regimes but experienced substantial recent weakening. The 10-day signal remained positive but failed the ICIR threshold, so it should be treated strictly as a five-day factor.

The newly validated factor is currently effective based on the latest full-history validation:

- **Breadth-Transition Amplified Residual Reversal**
  - Five-day IC: **+0.029295**
  - ICIR: **+0.093233**
  - Coverage: **97.776%**
  - Turnover: **0.150778**
  - Last validated: **2031-09-04**

Previously persisted residual-reversal, stress-gated, dispersion-gated, and volume-shock variants remain in the library, but their high overlap and weakening recent-regime performance warrant correlation and drift monitoring.

- Revalidate the new factor on a rolling recent window before increasing its portfolio influence.
- Compute deterministic pairwise correlation against existing residual-reversal factors.
- Explore breadth transitions using observation-only macro regimes, particularly VIX and DXY, without creating tradable signals for those instruments.
- Avoid persisting additional highly correlated residual-reversal variants unless they provide clear incremental performance and robust recent-regime behavior.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); M=R.mean(axis=1); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(130,len(P)-21):
 rr=R.iloc[i-119:i+1]; m=M.iloc[i-119:i+1]
 beta=rr.apply(lambda x:x.cov(m),axis=0)/(m.var()+1e-12)
 resid=R.iloc[i-19:i+1]-np.outer(m.iloc[i-19:i+1],beta)
 mom=resid.iloc[-10:].sum()
 vol=rr.std()+1e-12
 # continuation in quiet idiosyncratic regimes, contrarian after unusually dispersed regimes
 disp=R.iloc[i-4:i+1].std(axis=1).mean(); base=R.iloc[i-59:i+1].std(axis=1).mean()+1e-12
 ratio=disp/base
 gate=np.clip(ratio-1.0,-0.7,0.7)
 f=mom/(vol*np.sqrt(10))*(1+0.45*gate)-0.35*(-resid.iloc[-1]/vol)
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-09-16')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310918_dispersion_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:

P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index().ffill(); R=np.log(P).diff(); M=R.mean(axis=1); rows=[]; sig=[]

 f=mom/(vol*np.sqrt(10))*(1+0.45*gate)-0.35*(-resid.iloc[-1]/vol)
 for h in (5,10):

 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-09-16')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20310918_dispersion_momentum_signal.csv',index=False)

P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]

for h in (5,10):

 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-10-15')]:

S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20311016_smooth_tail_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)
 C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index().ffill(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
# volatility-adjusted medium trend, conditioned on breadth persistence; causal daily observations
for i in range(130,len(P)-21):
 r20=R.iloc[i-19:i+1].sum(); r60=R.iloc[i-59:i+1].sum(); vol=R.iloc[i-59:i+1].std()+1e-12
 trend=(0.65*r20+0.35*r60)/(vol*np.sqrt(40))
 breadth=(R.iloc[i-19:i+1]>0).mean(axis=1)
 persistence=(breadth.iloc[-5:].mean()-0.5)*2
 # dampen trend when breadth is unstable, emphasize names aligned with persistent breadth
 f=trend*(0.75+0.50*np.clip(persistence,-1,1))
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1
  z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-10-29')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal')
print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index().ffill(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(65,len(P)-21):
 r=R.iloc[i-59:i+1]; v=r.std()+1e-12
 # idiosyncratic 3-day reversal relative to contemporaneous cross-asset market move
 m=r.mean(axis=1); beta=r.apply(lambda x:x.cov(m),axis=0)/(m.var()+1e-12)
 resid=r.iloc[-3:]-m.iloc[-3:].values[:,None]*beta.values
 shock=resid.sum()/(v*np.sqrt(3))
 disp=r.iloc[-4:].std(axis=1).mean(); base=r.iloc[-59:].std(axis=1).mean()+1e-12
 # reversal is stronger after unusually high market dispersion, but bounded
 g=1+0.55*np.clip(disp/base-1,-0.8,0.8)
 f=-shock*g
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-10-29')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6))
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20311030_dispersion_shock_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

## Factor Mining Cycle Summary — miner_3

**Validation date:** 2031-10-30  
**Data through:** 2031-10-29  
**Universe:** 15 tradable benchmark instruments  
**Admission gates:** absolute daily IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR ≥ 0.0840

### Explored Factors

1. **Breadth-persistent medium-term trend**
   - Combines 20-day and 60-day returns.
   - Volatility-normalizes the trend signal.
   - Scales exposure according to recent cross-asset return breadth persistence.
   - Motivation: capture trend continuation when market breadth is stable.

2. **Dispersion-gated residual shock reversal**
   - Removes each asset’s rolling 60-day beta exposure to the cross-asset market return.
   - Reverses the most recent three-day residual shock.
   - Amplifies the reversal signal when short-term cross-asset dispersion is elevated.
   - Motivation: exploit short-term idiosyncratic recovery after unusually dislocated moves.

3. **Asymmetric residual reversal**
   - Uses a five-day beta-adjusted residual return reversal.
   - Volatility-normalizes the signal.
   - Applies an asymmetric adjustment based on downside versus upside residual movement.
   - Motivation: emphasize recovery from downside shocks while retaining cross-asset de-risking.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Breadth-persistent trend | 5d | 3,617 | 15.00 | 100.0% | -0.007578 | -0.024059 | 47.802% | 0.066463 | Failed |
| Breadth-persistent trend | 10d | 3,617 | 15.00 | 100.0% | -0.010022 | -0.032545 | 47.581% | — | Failed |

| Dispersion-gated residual shock reversal | 10d | 3,682 | 15.00 | 100.0% | +0.019166 | +0.061265 | 51.738% | — | Failed ICIR |

#### Regime observations

- **Breadth-persistent trend, 5d IC:**  
  2020–2024: +0.006260; 2025–2027: +0.009254; 2028–2029: -0.013843; 2030–2031-10-29: -0.086728.
- **Dispersion-gated residual reversal, 5d IC:**  
  2020–2024: +0.016680; 2025–2027: +0.025116; 2028–2029: +0.023400; 2030–2031-10-29: +0.019243.
- **Asymmetric residual reversal, 5d IC:**  
  2020–2024: +0.016818; 2025–2027: +0.023172; 2028–2029: +0.026121; 2030–2031-10-29: +0.018442.

The two residual-reversal candidates were directionally robust across regimes, but neither achieved the required ICIR threshold of 0.0840.

### Persistence Actions

No factors were persisted this cycle. All three candidates failed the benchmark admission criteria, primarily because their ICIR values were below threshold.

Signal artifacts and research scripts were generated for auditability:

- `scripts/miner_3_20311030_breadth_persistent_trend.py`
- `scripts/miner_3_20311030_breadth_persistent_trend_signal.csv`
- `scripts/miner_3_20311030_dispersion_shock_reversal.py`
- `scripts/miner_3_20311030_dispersion_shock_reversal_signal.csv`
- `scripts/miner_3_20311030_asymmetric_residual_reversal.py`
- `scripts/miner_3_20311030_asymmetric_residual_reversal_signal.csv`

No live account, backtest, step, order, or persistent date/account state was modified.

### Current Effective Factors

Previously persisted effective factors remain the current library members, including:

- `miner_3_20310904_breadth_transition_reversal_5d`
- `miner_3_20311016_smooth_tail_reversal_5d`

The 2031-10-16 smooth tail-scaled five-day reversal remains effective based on its latest recorded validation:

- IC: +0.030261
- ICIR: +0.095496
- Coverage: 97.787%
- Turnover: 0.150708
- Last validated: 2031-10-16

### Plans

- Avoid persisting the residual-reversal variants until their stability improves materially.
- Investigate orthogonal volatility-regime and cross-asset defensive factors with lower signal turnover.
- Test conditional combinations that distinguish trending, mean-reverting, and high-dispersion regimes without duplicating the existing reversal cluster.
- Continue monitoring the recently persisted smooth tail reversal for deterioration and library correlation.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
# Trend efficiency: directional 20d move divided by path length, scaled by inverse 20d risk.
# Uses only information through date i and tests forward close returns.
for i in range(90,len(P)-21):
 r=R.iloc[i-19:i+1]; move=r.sum(); path=r.abs().sum()+1e-12; vol=r.std()+1e-12
 f=(move/path)/(vol*np.sqrt(20))
 f=f.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna()
print('universe',len(U),'usable_dates',x.date.nunique(),'data_start',P.index.min().date(),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-11-12')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6) if len(w) else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20311113_efficiency_trend_signal.csv',index=False)

   - Result: failed due to negative IC and ICIR.

2. **Path-efficiency reversal**
   - Formula: negative of the path-efficiency trend signal.
   - Motivation: exploit short-horizon recovery after inefficient or extended 20-day moves, while normalizing for realized volatility.
   - Result: passed the benchmark IC and ICIR gates at the 5-day horizon.

#### Regime results for the accepted 5-day factor

The factor has been strongest in the most recent regime, but the early-period weakness and the small cross-section warrant conservative interpretation.

The newly added factor has the lowest observed turnover among the tested recent reversal candidates and may provide useful diversification, although its conceptual relationship to the existing reversal cluster should be monitored.

- Test library correlation and incremental contribution against existing reversal factors.

- Avoid admitting the trend-direction version unless its negative predictive relationship is intentionally incorporated and independently validated.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)
 C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
# Dispersion-gated relative reversal: fade 5d relative return, with a 1.5x boost
# when trailing 20d cross-asset return dispersion is above its causal 60d median.
for i in range(90,len(P)-21):
 r=R.iloc[i-4:i].sum(); med=r.median(); vol=R.iloc[i-20:i].std()+1e-12
 disp=R.iloc[i-19:i+1].std(axis=1).mean()
 hist=R.iloc[i-79:i+1].std(axis=1).mean()
 gate=1.5 if disp>hist else 1.0
 f=gate*(-(r-med)/vol).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna(); print('universe',15,'usable_dates',x.date.nunique())
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)
 print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2031-12-10')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6) if len(w) else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal')
print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20311211_dispersion_gated_relative_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

## Factor Mining Cycle Summary — miner_3

**Validation date:** 2031-12-11

**Universe:** 15 tradable cross-asset benchmark instruments

   - Fades each asset’s trailing 5-day return relative to the cross-sectional median, volatility-normalized.
   - Signal is amplified during elevated cross-asset dispersion.
   - Failed the ICIR gate.

   - Motivation: improve stability and reduce turnover relative to pure short-term reversal.
   - Failed the ICIR gate at both tested horizons.

   - Passed the 10-day IC and ICIR admission gates.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
# Candidate: dispersion-gated recovery reversal. Signal is causal 3d contrarian return,
# volatility scaled, amplified when trailing 20d cross-asset return dispersion is high.
for i in range(25,len(P)-21):
 r3=R.iloc[i-2:i+1].sum(); v=R.iloc[i-20:i].std()+1e-12
 disp=R.iloc[i-20:i].std(axis=1).mean()
 base=R.iloc[i-40:i].std(axis=1).mean()+1e-12
 gate=1+0.50*np.clip(disp/base-1,-1,1)
 f=(-r3/v*gate).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna(); print('universe',15,'usable_dates',x.date.nunique(),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1); print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-01-07')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6) if len(w) else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6)); pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320108_dispersion_gate_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
# Volatility-normalized medium momentum, conditioned on broad market trend:
# 20d return / 20d vol, multiplied by sign of the cross-sectional median 60d return.
# This uses only information available at signal date and adapts trend/reversal direction by regime.
for i in range(65,len(P)-21):
 r20=R.iloc[i-20:i].sum(); v20=R.iloc[i-20:i].std()+1e-12
 m60=R.iloc[i-60:i].sum(); regime=np.sign(m60.median())
 f=(r20/v20*regime).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
 sig += [{'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(a)} for s,a in f.items()]
 for h in (5,10):
  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','h','n','ic']).dropna(); print('universe',15,'usable_dates',x.date.nunique(),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
for h in (5,10):
 q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1); print('horizon',h,'dates',len(q),'meanN',round(q.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))
 for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-02-04')]:
  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6) if len(w) else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))

## Factor Mining Cycle Summary — miner_3

**Validation date:** 2032-02-19  
**Data through:** 2032-02-18  
**Universe:** 15 tradable cross-asset benchmark instruments  
**Admission gates:** absolute daily IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR ≥ 0.0840

### Explored Factors

1. **Slower regime-conditioned momentum**
   - Signal: 30-day return divided by 30-day volatility.
   - Direction conditioned on the sign of the cross-sectional median 90-day return.
   - Motivation: test whether slower regime identification improves the recent deterioration of the previously effective regime-normalized momentum factor.
   - Artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20320219_slow_regime_momentum_signal.csv`

2. **Downside-shock reversal**
   - Signal: negative 10-day return divided by trailing downside volatility over 60 days.
   - Motivation: identify assets experiencing unusually severe downside shocks that may subsequently recover.
   - Artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20320219_downside_shock_reversal_signal.csv`

3. **Blended relative-strength and downside-shock reversal**
   - Signal: equal-weighted percentile ranks of:
     - inverse 40-day relative strength, volatility normalized;
     - downside-shock reversal.
   - Motivation: combine medium-term relative reversal with short-term stress recovery while remaining interpretable.
   - Artifact: `scripts/miner_3_20320219_blended_reversal_signal.csv`

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Slow regime-conditioned momentum | 5d | 1,475 | 14.48 | 96.542% | +0.004368 | +0.013607 | 0.076543 | Failed |
| Slow regime-conditioned momentum | 10d | 1,466 | 14.31 | 95.389% | +0.020416 | +0.063976 | 0.076543 | Failed ICIR |
| Downside-shock reversal | 5d | 2,414 | 12.57 | 83.783% | +0.021823 | +0.068043 | 0.113766 | Failed ICIR |
| Downside-shock reversal | 10d | 2,404 | 12.45 | 83.017% | +0.020042 | +0.063012 | 0.113766 | Failed ICIR |
| Blended reversal | 5d | 2,414 | 12.57 | 83.783% | +0.022902 | +0.072290 | 0.099033 | Failed ICIR |
| Blended reversal | 10d | 2,404 | 12.45 | 83.017% | +0.020017 | +0.063504 | 0.099033 | Failed ICIR |

The downside-shock and blended reversal signals improved materially in the latest regime, but their full-history ICIR remained below the 0.0840 admission threshold. With only 15 assets, the results are directionally encouraging but should be interpreted conservatively.

### Regime Observations

- **Slow regime-conditioned momentum, 10d IC**
  - 2020–2024: +0.032312
  - 2025–2027: +0.059643
  - 2028–2029: −0.034674
  - 2030–2032-02-18: −0.106883

- **Downside-shock reversal, 10d IC**
  - 2020–2024: −0.007173
  - 2025–2027: +0.019941
  - 2028–2029: +0.003355
  - 2030–2032-02-18: **+0.073496**

- **Blended reversal, 10d IC**
  - 2020–2024: −0.022994
  - 2025–2027: +0.012112
  - 2028–2029: +0.012034
  - 2030–2032-02-18: **+0.095519**

The latest regime strongly favors reversal, particularly the blended signal, while slower regime-conditioned momentum has continued to weaken.

### Persistence Actions

No new factors were persisted. None of the candidates met both benchmark admission gates.

No live-account, backtest, step, order, account, or date actions were performed.

### Current Effective Factors

The previously persisted factor remains the latest miner_3 effective factor:

- `miner_3_20320205_regime_normalized_momentum_20d`
  - 10-day IC: +0.036798
  - 10-day ICIR: +0.110757
  - Coverage: 95.257%
  - Turnover: 0.088581
  - Last validated: 2032-02-05
  - Latest observed regime performance was adverse; use conservatively pending formal revalidation.

### Plans

- Continue testing reversal variants with improved persistence and lower turnover.
- Revalidate the existing regime-normalized momentum factor after a longer adverse-regime sample.
- Explore a regime-switching ensemble that reduces momentum exposure and increases downside-reversal exposure only when recent reversal IC remains positive.
- Avoid persisting the current candidates unless their ICIR exceeds the 0.0840 threshold on a consistent evaluation horizon.

## Factor Mining Cycle Summary — miner_3

**Validation date:** 2032-03-04  
**Data through:** 2032-03-03  
**Universe:** 15 tradable cross-asset benchmark instruments  
**Admission gates:** absolute daily IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR ≥ 0.0840

### Explored Factors

1. **Smoothed blended reversal**
   - Three-day temporal average of the previously tested blended reversal signal.
   - Combines:
     - inverse 40-day relative strength, volatility normalized;
     - downside-shock reversal over 10 days.
   - Motivation: reduce daily rank noise and turnover while retaining the recent reversal effect.

2. **Smoothed downside-shock reversal**
   - Three-day temporal average of downside-shock reversal ranks.
   - Signal uses negative 10-day return divided by trailing downside volatility over 60 days.
   - Motivation: test whether signal smoothing improves stability and reduces turnover.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|

| Smoothed blended reversal | 10d | 2,411 | 12.44 | 82.931% | +0.013072 | +0.042425 | 0.067871 | Failed ICIR |
| Smoothed downside-shock reversal | 5d | 2,423 | 12.56 | 83.706% | +0.015975 | +0.051336 | 0.092826 | Failed ICIR |
| Smoothed downside-shock reversal | 10d | 2,411 | 12.44 | 82.931% | +0.013120 | +0.041986 | 0.092826 | Failed ICIR |

  - `scripts/miner_3_20320304_smoothed_downside_reversal_signal.csv`

- Test regime-conditioned admission or interaction with cross-asset dispersion and defensive indicators.

- Revalidate the existing regime-normalized momentum factor after the extended adverse period.

ResponseFunctionToolCall(arguments='{"content":"import numpy as np,pandas as pd\\nfrom alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data\\nU=[\'000300.SH\',\'SPX\',\'HSI\',\'N225\',\'SX5E\',\'000688.SH\',\'SOX\',\'NDX\',\'XAU\',\'COPPER\',\'WTI\',\'BTC\',\'ETH\',\'US10Y\',\'CN10Y\']\\nC={}\\nfor s in U:\\n d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values(\'date\').drop_duplicates(\'date\').set_index(\'date\').close.astype(float)\\nP=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]\\n# Novel candidate: medium-horizon trend normalized by idiosyncratic volatility,\\n# gated by cross-sectional breadth. Positive breadth preserves trend; negative breadth reverses it.\\nfor i in range(75,len(P)-21):\\n r30=R.iloc[i-30:i].sum(); v60=R.iloc[i-60:i].std()+1e-12\\n breadth=(R.iloc[i-20:i].gt(0).mean(axis=1).mean()-0.5)\\n base=(r30/v60).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)\\n f=(base * (1 if breadth>=0 else -1)).rank(pct=True)\\n for s,v in f.items(): sig.append({\'date\':str(P.index[i].date()),\'symbol\':s,\'signal\':float(v)})\\n for h in (5,10):\\n  y=P.iloc[i+h]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({\'f\':f,\'y\':y}).dropna()\\n  if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],h,len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method=\'spearman\')))\\nx=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=[\'date\',\'h\',\'n\',\'ic\']).dropna(); print(\'universe\',15,\'usable_dates\',x.date.nunique(),\'data_end\',P.index.max().date())\\nfor h in (5,10):\\n q=x[x.h==h]; m=q.ic.mean(); sd=q.ic.std(ddof=1)\\n print(\'horizon\',h,\'dates\',len(q),\'meanN\',round(q.n.mean(),2),\'coverage\',round(q.n.mean()/15,5),\'IC\',round(m,6),\'ICIR\',round(m/sd,6),\'hit\',round((q.ic>0).mean(),5))\\n for a,b in [(\'2020-01-01\',\'2024-12-31\'),(\'2025-01-01\',\'2027-12-31\'),(\'2028-01-01\',\'2029-12-31\'),(\'2030-01-01\',\'2032-03-17\')]:\\n  w=q[(q.date>=a)&(q.date<=b)]; print(\'regime\',a,b,\'dates\',len(w),\'IC\',round(w.ic.mean(),6) if len(w) else None)\\nS=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index=\'date\',columns=\'symbol\',values=\'signal\'); print(\'turnover\',round(S.rank(axis=1,pct=True).diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))\\npd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv(\'scripts/miner_3_20320318_breadth_gated_trend_signal.csv\',index=False)\\n","file_path":"scripts/miner_3_20320318_breadth_gated_trend.py"}', call_id='call_5OEFDczqDqSRnA4sJYe5Qa6I', name='write_file', type='function_call', id='fc_028d168fba25f3e8016a8a4dc5dba887d0a72792bcc32956d5', caller=None, namespace=None, status='completed')

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date)
 C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
# Candidate: medium-term trend divided by downside volatility. Downside risk is
# estimated only from trailing negative daily log returns, avoiding future data.
for i in range(95,len(P)-11):
 trend=R.iloc[i-60:i].sum()
 down=R.iloc[i-90:i].where(R.iloc[i-90:i]<0).std().replace(0,np.nan)
 f=(trend/(down+1e-12)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan)
 f=f.rank(pct=True)
 for s,v in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)})
 y=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1
 z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); print('universe',15,'usable_dates',x.date.nunique(),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('horizon',10,'dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-03-31')]:
 w=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6) if len(w) else None,'ICIR',round(w.ic.mean()/w.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(w)>1 else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320401_downside_vol_trend_60d_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4000); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
# Residual reversal: remove each asset's trailing 60d beta to the equal-weight
# cross-asset return, then fade its 20d cumulative residual move.
M=R.mean(axis=1)
for i in range(80,len(P)-11):
 rr=R.iloc[i-60:i]; mm=M.iloc[i-60:i]
 beta=rr.apply(lambda x: x.cov(mm)/(mm.var()+1e-12))
 resid=rr.sub(mm,axis=0).mul(1-beta,axis=1) # simple beta-adjusted residual
 f=-resid.iloc[-20:].sum()
 f=f.replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rank(pct=True)
 for s,v in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)})
 y=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); print('universe',15,'usable_dates',x.date.nunique(),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('horizon',10,'dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.mean()/15,5),'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-04-14')]:
 w=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6) if len(w) else None,'ICIR',round(w.ic.mean()/w.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(w)>1 else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320415_residual_reversal_20d_signal.csv',index=False)

## Factor Mining Cycle Summary — miner_3

**Validation date:** 2032-04-15  
**Data through:** 2032-04-14  
**Universe:** 15 tradable cross-asset benchmark instruments  
**Admission gates:** absolute daily IC ≥ 0.0070 and absolute daily ICIR ≥ 0.0840

### Explored Factors

1. **20-day residual reversal**
   - Construction: estimate each asset’s 60-day beta to the equal-weight cross-asset return, compute beta-adjusted residual returns, and rank the inverse 20-day cumulative residual return.
   - Motivation: isolate idiosyncratic relative weakness and test whether residual losers mean-revert.

2. **5-day residual reversal**
   - Same residualization approach with a shorter 5-day reversal horizon.
   - Motivation: capture faster cross-asset mean reversion.

3. **Volatility-compression reversal**
   - Construction: inverse 20-day return multiplied by the ratio of short-term 10-day volatility to 60-day volatility, then cross-sectionally ranked.
   - Motivation: emphasize reversal signals emerging after volatility compression or expansion.

4. **Downside-volatility-normalized 60-day trend reversal revalidation**
   - Signal: `rank(-60d cumulative log return / 90d downside volatility)`.
   - Revalidated through 2032-04-14 to monitor factor aging and recent drift.

### Validation Results

| Factor | Horizon | Dates | Mean instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio | Turnover | Result |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 20d residual reversal | 10d | 2,447 | 14.58 | 97.22% | +0.011924 | +0.038093 | 49.90% | 0.075820 | Failed ICIR |
| 5d residual reversal | 10d | 2,454 | 14.58 | 97.23% | −0.001309 | −0.004124 | 50.00% | 0.146934 | Failed |
| Volatility-compression reversal | 10d | 2,451 | 14.55 | 96.97% | +0.019471 | +0.057798 | 53.86% | 0.080083 | Failed ICIR |
| Downside-volatility reversal, revalidated | 10d | 2,442 | 12.45 | 83.03% | +0.037815 | +0.116269 | 56.14% | 0.049958 | **Passed** |

#### Regime analysis

The admitted downside-volatility reversal factor showed:

- **2020–2024:** IC −0.023234, ICIR −0.069406
- **2025–2027:** IC +0.022102, ICIR +0.069095
- **2028–2029:** IC +0.028825, ICIR +0.097246
- **2030–2032-04-14:** IC +0.137230, ICIR +0.426833

The factor remains effective under the benchmark-wide gates, but performance is strongly regime-dependent and concentrated in the recent period. Results should therefore be blended with defensive and non-identical signals rather than used as a standalone portfolio driver.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4500); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(100,len(P)-11):
 r=R.iloc[:i]
 # downside-volatility normalized medium-term reversal
 down=r.iloc[-90:].clip(upper=0).std()
 base=-r.iloc[-60:].sum()/(down+1e-12)
 breadth=(r.iloc[-20:].sum()>0).mean()
 eqvol=r.iloc[-20:].mean(axis=1).std(); histvol=r.iloc[-120:].mean(axis=1).std()+1e-12
 # stress multiplier is causal and common across assets; mild attenuation avoids unstable gating
 stress=np.clip((0.5-breadth)*2,0,1)*np.clip(eqvol/histvol,0.5,2.0)
 f=(base*(1+0.60*stress)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rank(pct=True)
 for s,v in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)})
 y=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('universe',15,'usable_dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.mean()/15,5),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
print('horizon',10,'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-04-28')]:
 w=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(w.ic.mean()/w.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(w)>1 else np.nan)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320429_breadth_stress_downside_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4500); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(130,len(P)-11):
 r=R.iloc[:i]
 # short-horizon reversal, normalized by each asset's recent volatility
 vol=r.iloc[-40:].std()+1e-12
 base=-r.iloc[-20:].sum()/vol
 # dispersion regime: emphasize reversal when cross-asset return dispersion is elevated
 disp=r.iloc[-20:].std(axis=1).mean(); disp_hist=r.iloc[-120:].std(axis=1).mean()+1e-12
 gate=np.clip(disp/disp_hist,0.7,1.8)
 f=(base*gate).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rank(pct=True)
 for s,v in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)})
 y=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('universe',15,'usable_dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.mean()/15,5),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
print('horizon',10,'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-05-12')]:
 w=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(w.ic.mean()/w.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(w)>1 else np.nan)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))

from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4500); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(130,len(P)-11):
 r=R.iloc[:i]; vol=r.iloc[-60:].std()+1e-12
 base=-r.iloc[-30:].sum()/vol
 breadth=(r.iloc[-30:].sum()>0).mean()
 agg=r.iloc[-30:].mean(axis=1); av=agg.std(); lv=r.iloc[-120:].mean(axis=1).std()+1e-12
 stress=np.clip((0.5-breadth)*2,0,1)*np.clip(av/lv,0.5,2)
 f=(base*(1+0.5*stress)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rank(pct=True)
 for s,v in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)})
 y=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('universe',15,'usable_dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.mean()/15,5),'data_end',P.index.max().date()); print('horizon',10,'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-05-12')]:
 w=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(w.ic.mean()/w.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(w)>1 else np.nan)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6)); pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320513_medium_reversal_breadth_signal.csv',index=False)

{"read_file": "import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4500); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(100,len(P)-11):
 r=R.iloc[:i]
 # downside-volatility normalized medium-term reversal
 down=r.iloc[-90:].clip(upper=0).std()
 base=-r.iloc[-60:].sum()/(down+1e-12)
 breadth=(r.iloc[-20:].sum()>0).mean()
 eqvol=r.iloc[-20:].mean(axis=1).std(); histvol=r.iloc[-120:].mean(axis=1).std()+1e-12
 # stress multiplier is causal and common across assets; mild attenuation avoids unstable gating
 stress=np.clip((0.5-breadth)*2,0,1)*np.clip(eqvol/histvol,0.5,2.0)
 f=(base*(1+0.60*stress)).replace([np.inf,-np.inf],np.nan).rank(pct=True)
 for s,v in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)})
 y=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('universe',15,'usable_dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.mean()/15,5),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
print('horizon',10,'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-04-28')]:
 w=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(w.ic.mean()/w.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(w)>1 else np.nan)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320429_breadth_stress_downside_reversal_signal.csv',index=False)
"}

   - Construction: negative 20-day return divided by 40-day volatility, multiplied by a cross-asset dispersion regime multiplier.
   - Motivation: test whether short-term reversal becomes stronger when cross-asset return dispersion is elevated.

2. **Medium-reversal breadth factor**
   - Construction: negative 30-day return divided by 60-day volatility, with a weak-breadth and aggregate-volatility stress adjustment.
   - Motivation: evaluate a lower-frequency alternative to the existing 60-day downside-volatility reversal.

3. **Revalidation of breadth-stress downside-volatility reversal**
   - Construction unchanged: negative 60-day cumulative log return normalized by 90-day downside volatility, amplified during weak breadth and elevated aggregate volatility.
   - Causal signal artifact was regenerated through 2032-05-12.

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4500); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(120,len(P)-11):
 r=R.iloc[:i]
 # Defensive recovery: favor assets with contained recent risk and moderate drawdown recovery,
 # while avoiding a pure trend signal. All inputs end before decision date.
 v20=r.iloc[-20:].std(); v90=r.iloc[-90:].std();
 dd=(P.iloc[:i].iloc[-1]/P.iloc[:i].rolling(120).max().iloc[-1]-1)
 rec=r.iloc[-10:].sum()
 # low-volatility residual plus recovery from drawdown; ranks make cross-asset scale comparable
 f=(-0.65*(v20/(v90+1e-12)).rank(pct=True) + 0.35*rec.rank(pct=True) - 0.20*dd.rank(pct=True))
 # In high common volatility, emphasize the low-vol component; causal regime adjustment
 common=r.iloc[-20:].mean(axis=1).std(); longcommon=r.iloc[-120:].mean(axis=1).std()+1e-12
 stress=np.clip(common/longcommon,0.5,2.0)
 f=(-0.65*stress*(v20/(v90+1e-12)).rank(pct=True) + 0.35*rec.rank(pct=True) - 0.20*dd.rank(pct=True)).rank(pct=True)
 for s,v in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)})
 y=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('universe',15,'usable_dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.mean()/15,5),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
print('horizon',10,'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))
for a,b in [('2020-01-01','2024-12-31'),('2025-01-01','2027-12-31'),('2028-01-01','2029-12-31'),('2030-01-01','2032-05-26')]:
 w=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(w.ic.mean()/w.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(w)>1 else np.nan)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
pd.DataFrame(sig).to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20320527_defensive_drawdown_recovery_signal.csv',index=False)

import numpy as np,pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
C={}
for s in U:
 d=get_stock_daily_data(s,days=4500); d.date=pd.to_datetime(d.date); C[s]=d.sort_values('date').drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').close.astype(float)
P=pd.DataFrame(C).sort_index(); R=np.log(P).diff(); M=R.mean(axis=1); rows=[]; sig=[]
for i in range(100,len(P)-11):
 rr=R.iloc[i-80:i]; mm=M.iloc[i-80:i]
 beta=rr.apply(lambda x:x.cov(mm)/(mm.var()+1e-12))
 resid=rr.sub(mm,axis=0).mul(1-beta,axis=1)
 # Fade idiosyncratic 30d move, scaled by its recent residual volatility.
 rv=resid.iloc[-30:].std()+1e-12
 f=(-resid.iloc[-30:].sum()/rv).rank(pct=True)
 for s,v in f.items(): sig.append({'date':str(P.index[i].date()),'symbol':s,'signal':float(v)})
 y=P.iloc[i+10]/P.iloc[i]-1; z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'y':y}).dropna()
 if len(z)>=8 and z.f.nunique()>1: rows.append((P.index[i],len(z),z.f.corr(z.y,method='spearman')))
x=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['date','n','ic']).dropna(); m=x.ic.mean(); sd=x.ic.std(ddof=1)
print('universe',15,'usable_dates',len(x),'meanN',round(x.n.mean(),2),'coverage',round(x.n.mean()/15,5),'data_end',P.index.max().date())
print('horizon',10,'IC',round(m,6),'ICIR',round(m/sd,6),'hit',round((x.ic>0).mean(),5))

 w=x[(x.date>=a)&(x.date<=b)]; print('regime',a,b,'dates',len(w),'IC',round(w.ic.mean(),6) if len(w) else None,'ICIR',round(w.ic.mean()/w.ic.std(ddof=1),6) if len(w)>1 else None)
S=pd.DataFrame(sig).pivot(index='date',columns='symbol',values='signal'); print('turnover',round(S.diff().abs().mean(axis=1).dropna().mean(),6))
